scene_analysis.scene_overview: A sunny day in a city street with a large beige building on the right side of the street. The building has three stories and a flat roof. It has a cream-colored facade with a few windows and doors. There are two people standing outside the building. The street is paved with gray bricks and there are some parked motorcycles on the left side of the street. There is a tree on the right side of the street. The sky is blue and clear.
